run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the lexicographically largest subsequence where each character occurs at least k times
test_f_gold: test f_gold against filled function using parameter sets to verify correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a more efficient counting approach instead of nested loops
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that iterates reverse alphabet to build lexicographically largest subsequence
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the lexicographically largest subsequence with minimum k occurrences per character
